blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: While arousal can be reliably predicted from musical audio, emotional valence remains difficult to model due to its subjective and context-dependent nature. In this work, we investigate the potential of in-context learning (ICL) with large language models to advance continuous valence and arousal prediction. Rather than predicting emotion scores directly, our framework leverages contextual demonstrations from an auxiliary dataset to refine the initial predictions produced by a small, task-specific base model. We systematically evaluate a text-based ICL variant using lyrics and generated audio captions, alongside a multimodal variant that incorporates raw audio signals. Using the entire MER60 dataset strictly as a held-out test set, our experiments demonstrate substantial performance gains, particularly for valence. Text-based ICL improves the valence $R^2$ from 0.110 to 0.427 with 80 demonstration shots, while the multimodal variant achieves 0.346 with only 10 shots. These findings suggest that training-free ICL offers an effective inference-time strategy for current language models to predict continuous music emotion.
blocks.zh: 虽然从音乐音频中可以可靠地预测出振荡,但由于其主观性和环境依赖性,情感的华丽仍然难以建模. 在这部作品中,我们研究了用大语言模型来推进连续的振荡和振奋性的预测(ICL)学习(ICL)的潜力. 我们的框架不是直接预测情绪的得分,而是利用辅助数据集的背景演示来完善由小型任务特定基模型产生的初步预测. 我们利用歌词系统地评价一个基于文本的ICL变体,并生成音频标题,以及一个包含原始音频信号的多式联运变体。 严格地将整个MER60数据集用作一个搁置的测试集,我们的实验显示出了巨大的性能收益,特别是对于价值。 基于文本的ICL改进了价值$R^2美元,从0.110美元提高到0.427美元,并配有80个演示镜头,而多式联运变体仅配有10个镜头就达到了0.346个. 这些发现表明,无培训的ICL为当前语言模型预测持续音乐情感提供了一个有效的推论时间策略.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Music emotion recognition (MER) aims to estimate the perceived emotional response of listeners [ 28 , 14 ] . Emotions are typically modeled using categorical labels or continuous dimensions. In this work, we focus on the continuous valence–arousal framework [ 22 , 18 ] , where arousal indicates emotional energy and valence measures emotional positivity or negativity. While numerous classical [ 29 , 11 ] and deep learning methods [ 10 , 15 ] have been proposed to predict valence and arousal from musical audio, valence prediction remains challenging due to its highly abstract and context-dependent nature [ 29 , 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 音乐情感识别(MER)旨在估计听众的感知情感反应[28,14]. 情感一般采用绝对的标签或连续维来建模. 在这部作品中,我们集中关注的是连续的活泼——振奋性框架[22,18],其中振奋性表示情感能量和活泼性衡量情感的正向性或负向性. 虽然提出了许多古典[29,11]和深层学习方法[10,15],以预测从音乐音响中产生的能动性和振奋性,但能动性的预测因其高度抽象和对背景的依赖性而仍然具有挑战性. [29,8].

blocks.en: Recently, large language models (LLMs) and their multimodal counterparts (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across diverse tasks [ 24 , 21 , 23 , 25 ] . However, their direct zero-shot performance in continuous valence–arousal prediction from musical audio remains largely unexplored. In our pilot study, we employed MER60 [ 27 ] , a benchmark dataset of 60 Western pop songs compiled before 2011, to test two representative models: GPT-5 (a text-based LLM) and Qwen3-Omni 30B [ 25 ] (an MLLM). Evaluating with the coefficient of determination ( R 2 R^{2} ), where 1.0 indicates perfect prediction and negative values signal severe performance degradation [ 9 ] , GPT-5 achieved R A 2 = 0.699 R^{2}_{A}=0.699 for arousal but R V 2 = − 0.801 R^{2}_{V}=-0.801 for valence. Similarly, Qwen3-Omni 30B obtained R A 2 = 0.764 R^{2}_{A}=0.764 and R V 2 = 0.037 R^{2}_{V}=0.037 . While both models perform competitively on arousal—approaching established baselines in the literature (e.g., R A 2 = 0.800 R^{2}_{A}=0.800 reported in [ 11 ] )—their zero-shot valence predictions fail dramatically, falling far below prior audio-based benchmarks (e.g., R V 2 = 0.270 R^{2}_{V}=0.270 in [ 11 ] ). Crucially, because the songs in MER60 have been released for over 15 years, likely the text descriptions or audio clips related to them were already included in the massive pre-training corpora of the LLM/MLLM. The fact that zero-shot valence prediction remains poor indicates that potential song exposure or text-based memorization alone is insufficient for zero-shot valence reasoning, highlighting the need for explicit, context-guided alignment.
blocks.zh: 最近,大型语言模型及其多式联运模型(MLLMs)在各种任务中表现出了显著的能力[24、21、23、25]。 然而,他们的直接零发性能在连续的活泼中——从音乐音频中作出令人惊叹的预测——仍然基本上没有得到探讨. 在我们的试点研究中,我们采用了MER60 [27],这是2011年之前汇编了60首西方流行歌曲的基准数据集来测试两个代表性模型:GPT-5(一种以文字为基础的LLM)和Qune3-Omni 30B [25] (一种MLLM). 用确定系数(R 2 R^{2})进行评估,其中1.0表示完美预测,负值表示严重性能退化[9],GPT-5实现R A 2=0.699 R^{2}_{A}=0.699,但R V 2.=-0.801 R^{2}_{V}=-0.801 为valence. 同样,Qune3-Omni 30B获得了R A 2 = 0.764 R^{2}_{A}=0.764和R V 2. = 0.037 R^{2}_{V}=0.037. 虽然这两个模型在文献中以激发-接近既定基线(例如R A 2 = 0.800 R^{2}_{A}=0.800)进行竞争,但它们的零射值预测却大为失败,远远低于以往的有声基准(例如R V 2 = 0.270) (原始内容存档于2018-10-29). R^{2}_{V}=0.270 in [11]. 关键是,由于MER60中的歌曲已经发行了超过15年,因此可能与之相关的文字描述或音频剪辑已经被收录入了LLM/MLLM的大规模训练前体. 零射值预测仍然不佳这一事实表明,仅凭潜在歌曲曝光或文字记忆不足以进行零射值推理,凸显出需要明确,上下文引导的对接.

blocks.en: The goal of this work is therefore to study whether we can effectively improve the ability of current LLMs and MLLMs to predict valence from music. More specifically, since training such large-scale models from scratch is computationally prohibitive, we ask whether we can leverage the prominent in-context learning (ICL) paradigm [ 4 , 1 ] . By exposing pre-trained LLMs and MLLMs to contextual demonstrations consisting of music audio and emotion labels from an auxiliary dataset (specifically, CH818 [ 12 ] ) that is completely disjoint from our test set (i.e., MER60), we aim to boost their valence prediction performance. Because this ICL approach operates entirely at inference time and requires no weight updates or task-specific fine-tuning [ 4 ] , it provides a straightforward, flexible, and practical solution for MER.
blocks.zh: 因此,这项工作的目标是研究我们是否能够有效地提高当前LLMs和MLLMs从音乐中预测价值的能力. 更具体地说,由于从零开始培训这种大规模模型在计算上是令人望而却步的,我们询问我们是否能够利用突出的文本学习范式[4, 1]。 通过将预先训练的LLMs和MLLMs暴露于由一个辅助数据集(具体为CH818 [12])的音乐音频和情感标签组成的上下文演示中,这与我们的测试集(即MER60)完全脱节,我们的目标是提升它们的活性预测性能. 由于这种ICL方法完全在推论时间运行,不需要重量更新或任务特定的微调[4],它为市面汇率提供了一个直截了当的,灵活的,实用的解决方案.

blocks.en:
Figure 1 : Overview of the proposed framework. A base audio model produces initial valence–arousal (VA) predictions,
which are refined via in-context learning using either a text-only LLM (bottom) or a multimodal LLM (top).
blocks.zh:
图1:拟议框架概览。 一个基本的音频模型 产生初始的活性(VA)预测,
通过文本内学习加以精炼,使用只文本的LLM(下方)或多模式的LLM(上方)。

blocks.en: Specifically, text-only LLMs cannot process raw audio signals directly, necessitating text-based “surrogates” to represent the musical content of demonstration songs during ICL. Therefore, as our first research question, we evaluate the effectiveness of song lyrics versus automatic audio captions as surrogates. We consider lyrics under the assumption that they convey rich semantic and thematic context essential for valence perception. Similarly, for audio captions, large audio-language models (e.g., Qwen-Audio [ 6 ] ) can be prompted to extract high-level descriptions such as emotional atmosphere and mood dynamics. Furthermore, while MLLMs can ingest raw audio signals directly, we similarly evaluate whether augmenting the audio input with lyrics enhances valence prediction in a multimodal ICL setting.
blocks.zh: 具体来说,只有文本的LLMs不能直接处理原始音频信号,这就要求基于文本的"代理"在ICL期间代表演示歌曲的音乐内容. 因此,作为我们的第一个研究问题,我们评价歌曲歌词相对于自动音频字幕作为代词的有效性. 我们认为,歌词的假设是,歌词传达丰富的语义和主题背景,对价值感知至关重要。 同样地,对于音频字幕,大型音频语言模型(如:Quen-Audio [6])可以被激励来取出情感氛围和情绪动态等高层次的描述. 此外,虽然MLLMs可以直接摄取原始音频信号,但我们同样评价用歌词增加音频输入是否提高多式联运ICL环境中的活性预测。

blocks.en:
As our second research question, we study whether incorporating a small , task-specific deep learning model trained explicitly for valence prediction can further improve result.
The core idea is that a compact base model can collaborate with the large language models by simplifying the in-context learning task.
Specifically, instead of asking the language model to predict absolute valence values from scratch, we use the base model’s initial prediction as an anchor and prompt the LLM/MLLM to estimate a residual offset. This predicted delta is then added to the base estimate to refine the final emotion scores.
This base model is trained using the entire auxiliary dataset CH818,
ensuring that the overall framework maintains strict cross-dataset generalization.
blocks.zh:
作为我们的第二个研究问题,我们研究纳入一个为预测价值而专门培训的小型任务深入学习模式是否能够进一步改善结果。
核心思想是,一个紧凑的基础模型可以通过简化内文学习任务来同大语言模型合作.
具体来说,我们没有要求语言模型从零开始预测绝对值值,而是将基数模型的初始预测作为锚,并促使LLM/MLLM估算出一个剩余抵消. 这个预言的三角洲随后被加入到基数估计中来来完善最终的情感分数.
这个基础模型使用整个辅助数据集CH818来训练.
确保总体框架保持严格的跨数据集通论。

blocks.en: To provide further insights, we systematically investigate key factors such as the required number of demonstration shots and the impact of LLM/MLLM model capacity. Furthermore, we conduct all experiments for both valence and arousal to examine whether the observed gains are dimension-specific. Our findings show that ICL can indeed greatly improve the valence prediction capabilities of current LLMs and MLLMs, though current text-based and multimodal architectures exhibit different optimal configurations.
blocks.zh: 为了提供进一步的见解,我们系统地调查一些关键因素,例如所需的演示镜头数量以及LLM/MLLM模型能力的影响。 此外,我们进行所有有价值和有活力的实验,以审查所观察到的收益是否具有特定层面。 我们的研究结果表明,尽管目前基于文字的多模式结构显示出不同的最佳配置,但国际语言语言委员会确实能够大大提高当前LLM和MLLM的活性预测能力。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
MER research can be categorized in several ways, according to the emotion model (categorical or continuous emotions [ 28 ] ), the nature of affect (perceived or felt emotion [ 16 ] ), or the input modality (e.g., audio signals, lyrics [ 8 ] , or symbolic representations like MIDI [ 13 ] ).
In recent years, deep learning architectures incorporating convolutional/recurrent networks and pre-trained backbones have been studied for various MER settings [ 13 , 19 , 15 ] .
Here, we focus specifically on continuous, perceived MER from audio clips.
blocks.zh:
MER研究可以根据情感模型(分类或连续的情感[28]),影响的性质(感觉或感觉的情感[16]),或输入模式(如音频信号,歌词[8],或像MIDI[13]这样的象征性表现),以多种方式分类.
近年来,已经对各种市场汇率环境[13、19、15]研究了包含革命/经常网络和经过预先培训的骨干结构。
在这里,我们特别侧重于连续的,从音频剪辑中看到的市场汇率。

blocks.en:
The annotation quality of training datasets strongly affects the generalizability of MER models [ 11 ] . Recent audio-based continuous MER studies mostly rely on the DEAM dataset [ 2 ] , largely due to its public accessibility. However, DEAM was annotated via crowdsourcing,
leading to variable label quality.
In contrast, older datasets such as MER60 [ 27 ] and CH818 [ 12 ] were collected with expert-supervised annotation protocols, yielding substantially higher reliability, though restricted distribution has historically limited their usage.
As the creators of CH818 and MER60, we leverage both in this study. For evaluation integrity, we utilize CH818 (covering 818 Chinese pop clips with medium-to-high annotation rigor) as our auxiliary dataset for base model training and ICL demonstrations, while using the entire MER60 (60 Western pop with high annotation rigor) exclusively as the test set.
blocks.zh:
培训数据集的注释质量严重影响了市面汇率模型的通俗性[11]. 最近基于音频的连续市面汇率研究大多依赖于DEM数据集[2],这主要是因为其公开的可访问性. 然而,DEAM是通过众包注解的,
导致标签质量可变。
相形之下,用专家监督的注释协议收集了更古老的数据集,如MER60[27]和CH818[12],提高了可靠性,尽管限制分发历来限制了它们的使用。
作为CH818和MER60的创造者,我们在这项研究中同时发挥杠杆作用. 为了评价完整性,我们使用CH818(涵盖818个中高注音硬度的中国流行片段)作为我们的辅助数据集,用于基础模型培训和ICL演示,同时将整个MER60(60个有高注音硬度的西方流行)完全用作测试集.

blocks.en:
Recent advances in LLMs/MLLMs have spurred growing interest in applying foundation models to music [ 6 , 25 ] .
However, their application to MER remains nascent. To date, existing work such as Yang et al. [ 26 ] primarily explores LLMs for categorical emotion annotation for symbolic MIDI.
In contrast, our work targets the more challenging task of continuous valence–arousal regression directly from musical audio. Furthermore, while ICL has proven highly effective at enabling LLMs to perform complex reasoning via demonstrations [ 4 , 1 ] ,
its potential for continuous regression in audio and music remains largely unexplored.
blocks.zh:
近期在LLMS/MLLMs方面的进步,促使人们日益关注将基础模型应用于音乐[6,25].
然而,它们对于市面汇率的应用仍然是新生的。 至今已出有杨等作. [26]主要探索LLMs为象征性的MIDI的绝对情感注释.
反之,我们的工作目标是更具有挑战性的任务,即从音乐音响中直接产生持续的活泼性倒退。 此外,虽然国际天主教法律学院已证明在使法学硕士能够通过示范[4,1]进行复杂的推理方面非常有效,
其音频和音乐持续倒退的潜力基本上仍未得到探讨。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Our framework consists of two stages, as illustrated in Fig. 1 . Given an input audio 𝐱 \mathbf{x} , a base model f ⁡ ( ⋅ ) f(\cdot) first predicts an initial valence–arousal (VA) estimate 𝐛 = f ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) ∈ [ 1 , 9 ] 2 \mathbf{b}=f(\mathbf{x})\in[1,9]^{2} , where valence and arousal scores are normalized to the standard 1–9 scale. A second-stage LLM or MLLM g ⁡ ( ⋅ ) g(\cdot) then predicts a calibration offset Δ \Delta , yielding the final prediction 𝐲 ^ = 𝐛 + Δ \hat{\mathbf{y}}=\mathbf{b}+\Delta , which is clipped to the valid VA range.
Predicting the residual Δ \Delta instead of absolute VA values allows the second-stage model to focus only on correcting the base prediction.

预测所剩的 QQ \ Delta 而不是绝对的 VA 值,使得第二阶段模型只能专注于校正基础预测.

blocks.en: In our implementation, the base model follows the audio branch of Music2Emo [ 15 ] , replacing MERT [ 17 ] with BEATs embeddings [ 5 ] . For each clip, 5-second BEATs features are averaged into a 768-dimensional representation and fed into an MLP with batch normalization, ReLU, and dropout. The model is trained using AdamW (learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} ), batch size 64, and mean squared error (MSE) loss for 150 epochs.
blocks.zh: 在我们的实施中,基模沿用了Music2Emo [15]的音频分支,将MERT [17] 替换为 BEATs 嵌入 [5]. 每段片段,平均5秒BEAT的特性被编为768维的表示并被输入批量正常化的MLP,ReLU和辍学. 该模型使用AdamW(学习率10 - 4 10-QQ-4}),批量尺寸64,以及150个纪元的平均平方误差(MSE)损失来训练.

blocks.en:
As the zero-shot performance of current LLMs or MLLMs for VA prediction is unsatisfactory, we employ ICL by pre-pending N N demonstrations at inference time
for each testing audio clip (i.e., the “query”), where N N denotes the number of shots.
We investigate two variants in this work.
blocks.zh:
由于当前LLMs或MLLMs用于VA预测的零射出性能不尽人意,我们通过在推论时间预先等待N N 演示来使用ICL
N表示射击次数的每个测试音频片段(即“射击”)。
我们在本作中调查了两种变体.

The N N demonstrations and the query are serialized into a prompt, enabling the LLM to predict the calibration offset Δ = g ( text-ICL ) ​ ( 𝐛 , ℓ , s ) \Delta=g^{(\text{text-ICL})}(\mathbf{b},\ell,s) for the testing clip.

blocks.en: To obtain rich textual surrogates for the musical content, lyrics ℓ \ell are transcribed using Whisper-large-v3 [ 20 ] on vocal tracks isolated via HTDemucs source separation [ 7 ] . For audio descriptions s s , we prompt Qwen2-Audio [ 6 ] to generate one coherent text paragraph in English for each input audio clip that reflect “the listener’s feelings” covering the following aspects: i) overall emotion or mood of the song, ii) energy level and tempo feeling, iii) emotional color of melody and harmony, and iv) vocal or instrumental expression.
blocks.zh: 为了获得丰富的音乐内容的文字代词,歌词l\ell在通过HTDemucs源分拆隔离的相声道上被用Whisper-great-v3 [20]来转写. [7]. 关于音频描述 s.,我们请Qune2-Audio [6] 用英语为每个输入音频剪辑产生一个连贯的文本段落,反映 " 听众的感受 " ,涵盖以下几个方面:一)歌曲的整体情感或情绪;二)能量水平和节奏感;三)旋律和和谐的情感色彩;四)声调或工具表达.

blocks.en:
For multimodal ICL (MICL), as shown in Fig. 2 (b), the multimodal variant replaces the audio description with the original audio while maintaining the same underlying prompt structure, yielding Δ = g ( MICL ) ​ ( 𝐛 , ℓ , 𝐱 ) \Delta=g^{(\text{MICL})}(\mathbf{b},\ell,\mathbf{x}) .
Audio clips are processed directly by the MLLM’s native audio encoder, interleaving audio tokens with text in the context window.
This way, the model utilizes both acoustic and textual information.
blocks.zh:
对于多式ICL(MICL),如图2(b)所示,多式变体将音频描述替换为原始音频,同时保持相同的基础即时结构,生成QQ=克(MICL)(b,l,x)\Delta=gX(\text{MICL})}(\mathb{b},\ell,\mathb{x}).
音频剪辑由 MLLM 的本地音频编码器直接处理,将音频符号与上下文窗口中的文本相接.
这样,该模型既使用声学信息,也使用文字信息.

blocks.en: 4 Experiment
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We use CH818 [ 12 ] for base model training and ICL demonstrations, and MER60 [ 27 ] as the held-out test set. CH818 consists of 818 clips (30s each) annotated by 3 dedicated music experts, providing consistent medium-to-high annotation reliability. MER60 comprises 60 clips (also 30s each), each labeled by 40 human subjects in a controlled laboratory setup using a 2D emotional plane interface, providing ground truth labels with high annotation rigor ideal for evaluating ICL refinement. For each clip, we use the average VA values across annotators as the ground truth.
blocks.zh: 我们使用CH818[12]进行基模训练和ICL演示,并使用MER60[27]作为被搁置的测试设定. CH818由由3名专职音乐专家作注释的818个片段(每片30个)组成,提供一致的中高注释可靠性. MER60由60个片段(每个片段也是30个)组成,每个片段由40个人类主体在使用2D情感平面接口的受控实验室设置中标出,为评价ICL的精度提供了具有高注释刚性理想的地真道标签. 对于每个片段,我们使用平均VA值 跨注释者作为地面真相。

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation of the Base Model
blocks.zh: 4.1 对基地模式的评价

blocks.en:
We compare our base model with three existing ones, SVR [ 11 ] , VGGish [ 3 ] , and Music2Emo [ 15 ] , trained with different datasets.
As shown in Table 1 , while all models perform well on the validation split of their native training data, they generalize poorly to the out-of-domain MER60, particularly for valence prediction.
Our CH818-trained base model achieves the best cross-dataset performance among the deep learning models while remaining competitive with the classical SVR baseline, motivating its usage as the foundational anchor.
blocks.zh:
我们把基础模型和三个现有的模型进行比较 SVR [11], VGGish [3],和Music2 Emo [15],通过不同的数据集培训.
如表1所示,虽然所有模型在验证其本土培训数据方面都表现良好,但它们对域外的MER60的概括性差,特别是用于价值预测。
我们的CH818训练有素的基础模型在深层学习模型中实现了最佳的跨数据集性能,同时保持了与古典SVR基线的竞争力,激发了它作为基础锚地的使用.

blocks.zh: (a) 以文本为基础的《国际民法》的扩展效应

blocks.zh: (b) 对80发以下输入元件的校正研究

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation of Text-based ICL and MICL
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价基于文本的《国际民法》和《国际民法》

blocks.en:
We use GPT-5 as the LLM for text-based ICL, and Qwen3-Omni 30B [ 25 ] for MICL.
All inference runs adopt a decoding temperature of 0, and reported results are averaged over 5 independent runs with randomly sampled demonstrations.
blocks.zh:
我们使用GPT-5作为基于文本的ICL的LLM,并使用Qwen3-Omni 30B [25]作为MICL.
所有推论都采用0的解码温度,报告的结果平均为5个独立跑道,随机抽样演示。

blocks.en: Table 2 (a) shows the effect of the number of demonstrations for text-based ICL. Without ICL, GPT-5 obtains a much lower R V 2 R^{2}_{V} than the base model. Introducing only five shots greatly improves both R V 2 R^{2}_{V} and R A 2 R^{2}_{A} , while increasing the number of shots further benefits R V 2 R^{2}_{V} . This indicates that contextual demonstrations effectively guide refinement, and that larger in-context sets provide richer information for valence.
blocks.zh: 表2(a)显示基于文本的ICL演示次数的影响。 没有ICL,GPT-5获得比基模低得多的R V 2 R^{2}_{V. RV 2 R^{2}_{V}和RA 2 R^{2}_{A}), 这表明,背景演示可有效指导完善工作,更大的内文集为价值提供了更丰富的信息。

blocks.en: Table 2 (b) reports the corresponding input ablation under N = 80 N=80 (i.e., the best setting here). Using the base prediction alone does not work well, while removing the base prediction also degrades performance, validating the proposed two-stage framework. Among individual inputs, the audio description is the most informative, whereas lyrics alone contribute little. The best performance is achieved by combining all three inputs, suggesting that the base prediction provides a stable anchor, the audio description supplies the primary contextual information, and the lyrics offer complementary cues.
blocks.zh: 表2(b)报告了N=80N=80下的相应输入减值(即此处的最佳设置)。 单使用基数预测效果不好,而去除基数预测也会降低性能,验证拟议的两相框架. 在个人投入中,音频描述信息最多,而歌词本身贡献不大。 实现最佳表现的方法是将所有三种投入结合起来,建议基础预测提供稳定的锚地,音频描述提供主背景信息,歌词提供互补提示.

blocks.en: (a) Scaling effect of multimodal ICL
blocks.zh: (a) 多式联运的扩展效应

blocks.en: (b) Ablation study of input components under 10-shot
blocks.zh: (b) 对10发子弹下输入元件的校正研究

blocks.en: Table 3 : MICL results (mean±STD over five runs).
blocks.zh: 表 3:MIL结果(5次运行的平均值)。

blocks.en:
Table 3 reports the result for MICL.
Similar to text-based ICL, the MLLM performs poorly without demonstrations but improves substantially with only five shots, mainly for valence. Unlike text-based ICL, however, performance peaks at 10 shots and slightly degrades thereafter. We conjecture that the increasing context length caused by audio inputs limits the effectiveness of incorporating more demonstrations.
blocks.zh:
表3报告了多指标类集调查的结果。
与基于文本的ICL类似,MLLM在不进行示威的情况下表现不佳,但只有5发子弹就大有改观,主要用于活泼. 然而,与基于文本的ICL不同,性能高峰为10发,之后略有下降. 我们推测,音频输入造成的上下文长度增加限制了纳入更多演示的有效性。

blocks.en:
Table 3 (b) presents the input ablation under N = 10 N=10 . Unlike text-based ICL, the base prediction plays a more dominant role in MICL, as using it alone already achieves competitive performance, further supporting the two-stage framework. The best result is obtained by combining the base prediction with lyrics (ID 5). Adding audio descriptions slightly hurts R V 2 R^{2}_{V} ,
suggesting that raw audio provides sufficient acoustic information, rendering audio descriptions redundant.
blocks.zh:
表3(b)列出了N=10 N=10下的投入减值。 与基于文本的ICL不同,基础预测在MICL中起着更主要的作用,因为单用它就已经实现了有竞争力的性能,进一步支持了两阶段框架. 最佳效果是通过将基础预测与歌词(ID5)相结合来得到. 添加音频描述略为伤害了RV 2 R^{2}_{V} , (中文(简体) ).
说明原始音频提供了足够的声学信息,使音频描述变得多余.

blocks.en:
Finally,
for 80-shot text-based ICL, replacing GPT-5 by Qwen2-7B, Qwen3.5-122B, and GPT-5-mini reduces R V 2 R^{2}_{V} to 0.164, 0.285, 0.317, respectively.
For 10-shot MICL, replacing Qwen3-Omni-30B by Qwen2.5-Omni-3B and Qwen2.5-Omni-7B reduces R V 2 R^{2}_{V} to 0.123 and 0.308.
This suggests that larger models lead to better result in general.
blocks.zh:
终于
用于以80发为主的以文本为主的ICL,将GPT-5由Qune2-7B,Qune3.5-122B所取代;而GPT-5-mini将R V 2 R^{2}_{V}分别减少到0.164,0.285,0.317.
对于10发的MICL,将Qune3-Omni-30B被Qune2.5-Omni-3B和Qune2.5-Omni-7B所取代,将R V 2 R^{2}_{V}减为0.123和0.308.
这表明,更大的模式可导致总体效果更好。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We proposed an ICL approach for dimensional MER,
leveraging textual and multimodal demonstrations to
predict offsets that refine a base model prediction. Experiments on the high-quality but relatively small MER60 dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach.
Future work will seek ways to improve the multimodal ICL and expand the test data further.
Code, model checkpoint, qualitative interpretable reasoning examples, prediction results on non-MER60 audio clips, and extension to full-song prediction are available at https://github.com/DCN2001/MusicEmotionModeling .
blocks.zh:
我们提出一个ICL方法 对于维元MER,
利用文本示范和多式联运示范
预测可以抵消完善基准模型预测。 对高质量但相对较小的MER60数据集进行的实验表明这种方法的有效性。
今后的工作将想方设法改进多式ICL并进一步扩大测试数据。
代码、模式检查点、可定性解释的推理实例、非MER60音频剪辑的预测结果,以及扩展至全相声预测,可查阅https://github.com/DCN2001/MusicEmotionModeling。
